name: Carta de Naturalización por Matrimonio

requirements.blocker_text: Requires 2 years of continuous legal residence immediately preceding the application.
requirements.fix_path: Accrue 2 continuous years of legal residence.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a marriage to a Mexican citizen, registered with the Mexican civil registry, celebrated at least 2 years before the application.
Requires passing exams on Spanish language and Mexican history/culture, same as the residence-based track.
requirements.fix_path: Prepare for and pass the required exam(s).

requirements.blocker_text: Requires clean federal and local criminal background checks.

evidence_required.document: Temporary or permanent resident card (6+ months validity remaining)
Marriage certificate from the Mexican civil registry
Mexican spouse's birth certificate/nationality certificate/naturalisation letter and valid ID
Federal and local criminal background clearances

sources.title: Secretaría de Relaciones Exteriores (SRE) -- Carta de naturalización por haber contraído matrimonio con varón o mujer mexicanos

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Mexico's initial build. Genuinely reduced-period track compared to mx_naturalisation_residence: 2 years of residence here vs. the ordinary 5 years, PLUS a requirement that the marriage itself was celebrated at least 2 years before filing -- both conditions confirmed directly at tier-1. Kept as its own route file (see mx_naturalisation_residence's notes for why Mexico's separate SRE trámites are modelled as separate files rather than one OR-logic route).
